correctness.rationale: The polynomial centralizer parametrization is an exact K[t]-module Hom decomposition. Squaring gives the necessary and sufficient relation a(t)^2+bc t^(n−1)=0, with vanishing scalar coefficient and d=0; its t-adic order yields the two reduced varieties. The rank n−s for nonzero a, plus rank-one special elements for a=0, gives the polynomial enumerator by disjoint exhaustive cases. Irreducibility of u²+bc follows as a primitive degree-one polynomial in b; Jacobian analysis gives the singular locus over all characteristics. Standalone matrix-elimination tests are consistent and do not substitute for the proof.
